signature.name: VTask.structureMap
signature.type: {ι : Type u_1} -> (R : ι → Type u_2) -> (A : (i : ι) → Set (R i)) -> (𝓕 : Filter ι) -> (x : (i : ι) → ↑(A i)) -> RestrictedProduct (fun i => R i) (fun i => A i) 𝓕

conventions.note: NONE_DECLARED: The structure map is a total construction; every input yields a well-defined element of the restricted product with no junk-value or boundary conventions needed.

facts.statement: ∀ {ι : Type*} (R : ι → Type*) (A : (i : ι) → Set (R i)) (𝓕 : Filter ι), Set.range (VTask.structureMap R A 𝓕) = {f | ∀ i, f.1 i ∈ A i}

provenance.note: authored by eu.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6; certified by the v1.2 kernel validation ladder

facts.statement: ∀ {ι : Type*} (R : ι → Type*) (A : (i : ι) → Set (R i)) (𝓕 : Filter ι) (f : RestrictedProduct (fun i => R i) (fun i => A i) 𝓕), f ∈ Set.range (VTask.structureMap R A 𝓕) ↔ ∀ i, f.1 i ∈ A i

provenance.note: authored by eu.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6; unvalidated by the v1.2 kernel validation ladder

facts.statement: ∀ {ι : Type*} (R : ι → Type*) (A : (i : ι) → Set (R i)) (𝓕 : Filter ι) (f : RestrictedProduct (fun i => R i) (fun i => A i) 𝓕), (∀ i, f.1 i ∈ A i) → ∃ x : (i : ι) → ↑(A i), VTask.structureMap R A 𝓕 x = f

facts.statement: ∀ {ι : Type*} (R : ι → Type*) (A : (i : ι) → Set (R i)) [∀ i, TopologicalSpace (R i)] (x : (i : ι) → ↑(A i)), nhds (VTask.structureMap R A Filter.cofinite x) = Filter.map (VTask.structureMap R A Filter.cofinite) (nhds x)

facts.statement: ∀ {ι : Type*} (R : ι → Type*) (A : (i : ι) → Set (R i)) (𝓕 : Filter ι) (x : (i : ι) → ↑(A i)) (i : ι), (VTask.structureMap R A 𝓕 x).1 i ∈ A i
